messages:
Maria L.: Quick heads-up — OrbitApps (CUST-8891) was double-billed for March. Invoice INV-2026-0319 has two identical usage lines; total shows $2,400 but it should be $1,200. Requesting a manual goodwill credit of $1,200. Link to usage export: https://drive.redwood/finance/OrbitApps_INV2026-0319.csv. Need approval, GL code, and who will post the adjustment.
finance-bot: Billing alert created: INC-2026-0423 (duplicate usage ingestion) :rotating_light:
Alex J.: Do we know root cause? Metering bug or duplicate ingestion from the collector? Also what GL should we use for the credit? cc @Sophie (Billing)
Sophie (Billing): Looks like duplicate ingestion from usage-collector based on the export. We can either issue a negative invoice line (manual credit memo) or apply a promo credit. Accounting prefers a credit memo for refunds/waived charges. Use GL 6302 (Customer Credits). If Finance approves, I can create & post the credit memo today.
David K.: Approve $1,200 goodwill credit. Please include memo: "Duplicate usage ingestion — March 2026" and tag project orbit-integrations. Going forward let's cap goodwill credits at $5k/customer/year unless exec-approved. @Sophie please proceed.
Sophie (Billing): Got it. I'll prepare credit memo and AR adjustment. Draft ledger entry for audit:
```
Date: 2026-04-23
Account: 6302 - Customer Credits
Customer: CUST-8891 (OrbitApps)
Amount: -1,200.00
Memo: Duplicate usage ingestion — INV-2026-0319
Reference: CM-2026-XXXX
```
Do we refund to card or leave as account credit? Per T&Cs, account credit is default; confirm preferred path.
Maria L.: Account credit is fine — Orbit asked for a credit to their account rather than a refund. Also please notify CSM with a short customer-facing message. Suggested copy: "Hi — we've issued a $1,200 credit to your account for duplicate billing on March invoice INV-2026-0319. You can apply this credit to future invoices. Sorry for the inconvenience. — Redwood Billing"
finance-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-1123 queued for posting by Sophie.
Sophie (Billing): CM-2026-1123 posted to AR. GL 6302 applied, memo added, customer balance updated. Audit link: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1123. I emailed the CSM and cc'd Maria with the customer-facing note.
Alex J.: Thanks — can someone open an engineering ticket to fix usage-collector duplication? We should avoid repeating this.
Maria L.: Created ENG-5128 for duplicate ingestion fix and follow-up. Assigned to infra. I'll add a weekly check until root cause fixed.
David K.: Assigned to infra and accepted. Please include regression test in the ticket.
Maria L.: Closing loop — credit posted, customer notified, ticket created ENG-5128. Marking this thread resolved from finance side. :white_check_mark:
